pages.text: $(d)Platforms$()$(br2)$(d)Platforms$() are solid from the top, but not from the bottom or sides.$(br2)Additionally, sneaking will allow you to fall through them.

$(d)Super Lubricant Platform$()$(br2)The $(d)Super Lubricant Platform$() works the same, but works like other $(l:irregular_implements:blocks/super_lubricated_blocks)Super Lubricated blocks$(/l) and negates all friction.$(br2)This makes it very useful for transporting items.

$(d)Filtered Super Lubricant Platform$()$(br2)The $(d)Filtered Super Lubricant Platform$() works the same, but can hold an $(l:irregular_implements:filter/item_filter)Item Filter$(/l).$(br2)Anything matching the filter will fall through the platform.
